CVE-2026-110715.title: MuJS 1.3.6 before 1.3.9 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and wr ...
CVE-2026-110715.description: MuJS 1.3.6 before 1.3.9 contains a heap out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability in Array.prototype.sort that allows attackers to corrupt memory by inflating a simple array's length. Attackers can supply JavaScript that enlarges a dense array's length and calls sort, causing Ap_sort_cmp and Ap_sort_swap to access slots past the buffer and crash the process.

CVE-2026-88362.description: MuJS e892c9fdb contains an incorrect numeric conversion vulnerability in jsR_isindex() in jsrun.c. A specially crafted JavaScript input containing an excessively large numeric array index can cause an out-of-range floating-point value to be converted to an integer without proper range validation. This results in undefined behavior and can cause process termination, leading to denial of service.
